title: Spec Tasks list leaves the Tests task unchecked although the diff contains all the test work
evidence: spec-self-employed-copy-fix.md:72: "- [ ] Tests — strengthen the three checklist assertions to pin the new clause; add an auto-reply checklist assertion; run format/test/build" — while server/test/notification/email_client_test.gleam:151 adds "pub fn auto_reply_html_contains_checklist_ruling_test()" and the diff strengthens the invite/reminder-1/reminder-2/prep-block assertions exactly as the task describes.
detail: Every other Execution task is marked [x]; the Tests task is [ ] despite its full contents (strengthened checklist assertions on all four email surfaces + prep block, new auto-reply assertion, new label tests) landing in the diff. Contradicts the spec's own Tasks & Acceptance state.
recommended_fix: Flip the Tests checkbox to [x] in spec-self-employed-copy-fix.md (or delete the task list post-completion) so the spec of record reflects the shipped state.
